Overview & Security

Why Multi-Repo Fleets Drift

Independent Crons Break

Scattered schedules miss vendor doc changes and diverge silently.

Downstream Copy-Paste Stalls

Merged upstream fixes leave portfolio bundles pinned to stale commits.

  • 6
    Tracked Fleet Repos
    5 upstreams + 1 portfolio
  • 1
    Declarative Manifest
    sdlc.yaml owns every edge
  • 0
    Webhook Servers
    100% GitHub Actions native
Overview & Security

Five Workstreams, One Control Plane

Zero-Infrastructure State

Actions variables (SDLC_SYNC_STATE_*) hold ETag and SHA watermarks, with no external database.

Overview & Security

Six Permissions, Zero Autonomous Merges

6-Permission App Ceiling

mfg-msft-ai-sdlc holds only contents, pull_requests, issues, actions, variables, and metadata.

AWF Firewall Sandbox

Agent turns run in gh-aw strict mode, with dependencies pre-installed and domains allowlisted.

Immutable Post‑Agent Gates

Tests, builds, and zero-diff checks run outside the agent before safe_outputs.

Workstreams & Cascade

S1 · Manifest & Deterministic Reconciler

S1
SPEC-01 · Reconciler
specs/01-manifest-and-reconciler.md
Schema Gate
Validates sdlc.yaml against schemas/sdlc.schema.json, then cross-field semantic rules.
Compiler Pipeline
Renders .md workflows, then runs gh aw compile --strict --purge.
Token & Merge Guardrails
Scopes each App token to its edge's repositories and rejects auto-merge.
Workstreams & Cascade

S2 · Upstream Drift & Remote-Only Harness

Why a separate folder?
Local sessions load .github/agents/, never .github/sdlc/; only remote runs read it.
Three Specialist Roles
source-verifier corroborates changes, curriculum-updater edits labs and decks, regression-tester runs validators.

specs/02-upstream-drift-automation.md

Workstreams & Cascade

S3 · Hybrid Push + ETag Event Router

  1. Push
    sdlc-bridge-dispatch.yml posts upstream_pr_merged on a merge in this repository.
  2. Check
    route-upstream.mjs sends If-None-Match and compares recorded state.
  3. Dispatch
    Router starts cascade-mechanical-* or cascade-ai-* with a correlation id.
  4. Every 6 h
    Poll at :17 covers every other upstream; 304 answers cost no primary rate limit.

specs/03-event-routing-and-mechanical-cascade.md

Pilot & Onboarding

S5 · Self-Cascade & Two-Command Onboarding

Bootstrap & Onboard CLI

sdlc-bootstrap.mjs provisions the App and state variables; sdlc-onboard.mjs writes manifest entries.

node bin/sdlc-bootstrap.mjs
node bin/sdlc-onboard.mjs --repo <owner/repo>

specs/05-packaging-bootstrap-and-governance.md

Self-Cascading edge: ai-sdlc

edgeId: ai-sdlc
upstreamRepo: johnhain-msft/mfg_msft_ai_sdlc
downstreamRepo: johnhain-msft/portfolio
mode: mechanical
importCommands:
  - npm run import:ai-sdlc -- <checkout>
Pilot & Onboarding

Architecture Check: Who Grades the Agent?

An adaptation agent edits a locked test file. What happens?

Answer: B. Gates run outside the agent turn; safe_outputs depends on them.

Takeaways

Declarative, Sandboxed, Self-Cascading

Declare Fleet Intent

Keep watch URLs, verify gates, and cascade edges in sdlc.yaml (SPEC-01).

Isolate Agent Execution

Bound AI turns with .github/sdlc/, awf sandboxing, and deterministic post-steps (SPEC-02, SPEC-04).

Automate the Cascade

Pair push bridge dispatch with ETag polling and human-merged PRs (SPEC-03, SPEC-05).
